descriptor: Cross-Representation Witness Transport, Provenance–Relation Equivalence Classes, Minimal Sufficient Archive Encoding & SVEC Representation-Invariance Test

predecessor.interpretation: P22 maps representation dependence directly rather than assuming P21 success.

equivalence_classes.WITNESS_VALID: history-discriminating provenance source linked to oracle intervention by a history-sensitive relation
equivalence_classes.WITNESS_NULL: same provenance linkage but history-invariant target relation
equivalence_classes.WITNESS_INSUFFICIENT: history-sensitive target wording without a history-discriminating provenance contrast

representations.alpha_permuted: alpha-renamed identifiers plus list/trace permutation; same latent graph
representations.minimal: only the provenance contrast and target relation retained

frozen_gate.valid_cross_representation_transport: >=3/4 worlds correct across all three representations
frozen_gate.null_cross_representation_transport: >=3/4 worlds correct across all three representations
frozen_gate.program_level: >=2 evaluable models pass full invariance gate

authority: PASS establishes behavioral SVEC representation-invariance only over the frozen equivalence class and supports the tested minimal encoding. No claim of arbitrary-representation invariance or universal sufficiency. No post-hoc threshold changes.
